name: Roy Lake State Park (East Unit)
waterfront_evidence: 2026-11-22: Esri World_Imagery at 500 m half-width (1.1 m/px) and two 110 m half-width frames (0.24 m/px) over the west shore row and the south cul-de-sac, every Go Outdoors SD facID=55 loop 89 (East Unit) unit point plotted; all frames rendered. West shore row 56E/57E/60E/62E/64E/65E: gravel back-ins whose ends sit ~30-35 m from Roy Lake, with a continuous belt of trees along the whole shore between pads and water. South cul-de-sac 66E/68E/69E/70E: pad ends ~25-40 m from the lake, again behind a continuous tree fringe (tent sites T8/T9 nearer the water). No RV pad has open ground to the water, so not lakefront; the lake is in filtered view from the shore rows -> lakeview (stored value kept, evidence re-measured for the East Unit alone after the West Unit split).
inclusion_evidence: Go Outdoors SD engine https://reservations.gooutdoorssouthdakota.com/FacilityDetails.aspx?facID=55 ('Roy Lake State Park'), sitesHashMap read 2026-11-22, active units of loop 89 (the East Unit): 37 web-bookable electric RV sites 54E-87E and 88-90, every one 'Back-In Campsite', 'Amp Service: 20/30', MaxEquipLength 45-80 ft, UnitBasePrice $30; tent-only T6-T9 ($16); camping cabins C1-C2 ($60); host V3 (20/30/50) not sold online. Engine alert: 'New campsites have been added to the East Unit. East Unit Campsite Numbers Have Changed.' GFP campground map https://gfp.sd.gov/userdocs/roy_cg.pdf (modified 2026-03-31), EAST UNIT inset: the same numbering, restroom/shower building, vault toilets, water, swim beach, boat ramp and dump station. Esri imagery 2026-11-22: gravel back-in pads at the unit points on two loops and a south cul-de-sac, reached by the unit's own road south from the shore road. Real drive-in RV campground; a 23-ft rig fits every RV site (shortest 45 ft, 62E). The West Unit (loop 90), 2.84 km away RV-site centroid to centroid, was split out 2026-11-22. Public (state): no price gate.
note: Roy Lake State Park's East Unit campground, on the east shore of Roy Lake SW of Lake City, with its own access road, swim beach and boat ramp. The West Unit campground, beside the park's modern cabins, suites and store about 3 km across the lake, is a separate entry. Shore sites 56E-70E look at the lake through a belt of trees. --Claude

sites.note: Plus tent-only sites T6-T9 and camping cabins C1-C2.
